topics.description: Covers travel booking, accommodation, daily allowances, and expense claim procedures.

evidence.quote: To simplify expense reporting and cover incidental costs such as meals, local transportation, and miscellaneous expenses, the company provides a daily allowance (per diem).
All expenses incurred during business travel must be documented and submitted for reimbursement through the company's digital platform.
The approval workflow for expense claims is tiered based on the total value of the claim to ensure appropriate oversight.

Any request for remote work must be discussed and approved by the direct manager prior to implementation.
